source: Owner messages in a Claude Code session (mid-turn, while Stage 310 was being finished)

supersedes.OWNER_DECISIONS_9_2026-10-15.json#Q8visu: The session no longer makes and picks among its own prototypes; the owner's concepts set the direction

messages: Делаю правку. Весь арт должен делать GPT. Я вижу что рыночную площадь и поле боя рисовал ты, а не модель от openai
в проекте были концепты. GPT должен был их делать
Вот по этим концептам нужно строить. GPT будет все нужное генерировать. Art, наборы assets, UI, equip, skins, models, etc.

decisions.artByGpt: Every picture in the product is made by an OpenAI image model (GPT): concepts, scenes, portraits, battle-map pieces, item and spell art, figures, textures, ornaments, icons. Claude never draws illustration (no hand-made SVG or CSS pictures). Code draws only exact game markup over GPT art: grid, selection and side rings, movement path, area preview, bars, text and controls.
decisions.Q8visualDirection: The owner's seven concept images (docs/design/stage-320/owner-concepts/, made with GPT) are the visual direction for Stage 320 and the art style for Stage 330 (Q6). The session's three Claude-drawn prototypes are withdrawn: they are not art and are not kept in the product.
decisions.assetScope: GPT generates all needed art, asset sets, UI graphics, equipment art, skins and figures ('Art, наборы assets, UI, equip, skins, models, etc.'). Curated and UI-kit pictures go through Codex CLI on the owner's ChatGPT subscription (owner decision Q6, 2026-10-15); in-play pictures go through the OpenRouter OpenAI image model within the $5 ceiling.

sessionNotes: The concepts carry the placeholder brand 'D&D NEXT'. D&D is a third-party trademark; the product keeps its own name (Living Tabletop World / «Живой настольный мир») with a GPT-made emblem.

The concepts show features beyond the alpha (level-up, a 120-spell book, a world map of regions, a relationship graph, triggers, voice input). Stage 320 is presentation only; docs/STAGE_320_DESIGN.md maps each concept element to an existing surface or lists it as outside the alpha.
